relationships.evidence_quote: NGF acts on its high-affinity receptor, TrkA

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF upregulates the expression of neurotransmitters such as CGRP, substance P, and brain-derived neurotrophic factor

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: The activation of NGF/TrkA signaling results in the upregulation and release of inflammatory mediators, and the increased activation of TRPV1 and Nav1.8

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, IL-1β increased expression of NGF which mediated pain genesis [79,80].

relationships.subject: CCL2
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrated that neuronal CCL2 and CCR2 from DRG play vital roles in mediating macrophage infiltration and OA pain sensitivity.

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: In the second phase, the assembly of the inflammasome is triggered resulting in the activation of caspase 1 and release of IL-1β and IL-18

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: A single injection of TNF in the knee induced the persistent dose-dependent sensitization of peripheral sensory neurons, which was detected by mechanical allodynia

key_findings: Review of OA pain mechanisms: NGF/TrkA, CGRP, CCL2/CCR2, TNF-α, IL-1β, NLRP3 and Wnt/β-catenin
CGRP antibodies lacked efficacy in a phase II OA pain trial
